Un-700 gr

Yog’-2 osh qoshiq 
tayyorlagan hamirimizzi teng 2 ga bo’lib tindirib qo’yamiza 
Omihta tayyorlab olamiza 
Maselka yoki mechta 80% -65 gr

Gazdan olib
Mol yog’i 65 gr 
O’simlik yog’i -50 gr solamiza o’zi erib ketadi 

Tingan hamirlarimizzi yuqa qilib yoyvolib 1 chi hamirri yoyib omihtamizzi surib azgina qurishshi boshlaganida ikkinchi hamirimizzi ustiga solib yana omihtamizzi surib azgina qotgandan keyin o’zimizga azgina tortib tortib o’ravolamiz va holadilnikka 1 soatga yoki yarm soatga qo’yib somsalarimizzi tugib piwirvosek bo’ladi 🥰
